summary: Measured validator coverage of the 194 criteria the deterministic coverage check abstains on (FORM), across 84 unit records from 60 committed trace files. 68% addressed (evidence names the criterion and judges it), 20% glossed (partial address), 12% unattributable (no evidence item relates). Clause (ii) — the largest abstention class at 140/194 and the trigger for this measurement — is the best covered at 71% addressed, 88% addressed-or-glossed. Recommendation: Option A (validator suffices). Suite 970/970, $0.00.
recommendation_driver: Clause (ii) is 72% of all abstentions and its coverage is the strongest (71-88%). If clause (ii) were poorly covered, Option B would be justified regardless of the aggregate. It is not.
tier1_compute_observation: The one Tier 1 word count criterion is addressed by both the deterministic compute and the validator — redundant but justified as the deterministic check is free and correct.
glossed_inflation: The glossed category is inflated by verbose criteria that dilute the term-overlap denominator. Spot-checking shows many glossed items are genuinely addressed from a human reader's perspective. A generous reading puts addressed-or-glossed at 88%.
limitation: 60 trace files from this repo's committed scenarios — a convenience sample, not a distribution over all objectives. The validator model, serving, prompt, and objective distribution are not controlled.

questions_answered.attributability_question: Attribution is NOT unattributable for most criteria (68-88% are attributable). The question does not arise in its strong form. However, a typed judge layer would make per-criterion attribution mechanical rather than heuristic.
questions_answered.standing_rule_on_committed_traces: Yes — every command in this sequence assumes committed traces are subjects for new measurement without a new run. No command contradicts this.
questions_answered.threshold_question: The 12% unattributable rate is the number; the owner sets the threshold. This measurement does not invent one.

verification_results.result: Empty — no dependency or instrument change
